propositions: Seven REVIEW_RESULT audit payloads from preserved AWS review-bot clone must be selectively transplanted onto current tickets epoch using batch_write_and_push with exact event counts validated.
Five CREATE events and nine bidirectional LINK (relates_to) events must be validated, staged atomically, and committed in one path-scoped batch without codebase file changes.

Fresh-clone verification must confirm five new code-review artifacts, seven structured review results across six artifacts, nine relations, and zero resurrection of 1,520 removed aliases or 66 divergent enrichment events.
Canonical writer must reject enrichment events (ENQUEUE_ENRICH, CLAIM_ENRICH, DONE_ENRICH), removed comment aliases, and path collisions before mutation.
Back-out strategy must support additive, path-scoped deletion of exactly 21 manifest paths via event_append.delete_events if post-publication verification fails.
